title: Remote oral and open-book software engineering exams
summary: Third-year students in Reactive Programming and Artificial Intelligence complete either remote oral interviews or timed open-book home exams. GPT-4 can answer much of the written format, while oral exams use adaptive questioning, recorded video, and reflection to authenticate understanding.
